mapper.select: select approval_status from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0'
select type from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0'
select creator_id from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0'

select count(1) from documents d where d.id=#{documentId} and d.deleted='0' and (d.creator_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from workflow_tasks t join workflow_instances i on i.id=t.instance_id where i.document_id=d.id and (t.assignee_id=#{userId} or t.acted_by=#{userId})))
select count(1) from document_attachments where document_id=#{documentId}

select a.id,a.document_id,a.file_id,a.version_id,a.attachment_type,f.original_name,f.storage_path,f.media_type,f.size_bytes,f.sha256,a.created_by,a.created_at from document_attachments a join attachment_files f on f.id=a.file_id where a.document_id=#{documentId} order by a.created_at,a.id

select a.id,a.document_id,a.file_id,a.version_id,a.attachment_type,f.original_name,f.storage_path,f.media_type,f.size_bytes,f.sha256,a.created_by,a.created_at from document_attachments a join attachment_files f on f.id=a.file_id where a.document_id=#{documentId} and a.file_id=#{fileId}
mapper.delete: delete a from document_attachments a join documents d on d.id=a.document_id where a.document_id=#{documentId} and a.file_id=#{fileId} and d.approval_status in('DRAFT','RETURNED') and d.deleted='0'
